methodology.recall: Recall = (disasters fully forecast + 0.5 × disasters partly forecast) ÷ significant disasters that started on or after our first advance forecast.
methodology.f1: F1 = 2 × precision × recall ÷ (precision + recall). It combines the two into one score. It is not a measure of accuracy.
methodology.partialHitWeight: A partly correct forecast counts as 0.5. It was right about the hazard and the period but wrong about part of the place, so it counts as half.
